title: Bulk RNA-seq Protocol for Astrocytes
author: Elena Coccia
materials: Extract total RNA using the Qiagen RNeasy kit.
Proceed with the Qiagen RNeasy kit protocol for RNA following the manufacturer's instructions
Standard Illumina-compatible library preparation, single indexing
Illlumina HiSeq platform. Paired-end, 150 bp reads
Differential expression analysis with edgeR in R (v2023.12.0+369)
Visualization and functional enrichment with ggplot2 and clusterProfiler
Proceed with the Qiagen RNeasy kit protocol for RNA following the manufacturer's instructions

steps.title: Remove culture media
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard the media from the 2D astrocyte cultures.

steps.title: Scrape cells into PBS
steps.instruction: Scrape the adherent astrocytes directly into 50 mL of ice‑cold PBS.

steps.title: Centrifuge cells
steps.instruction: Transfer the PBS suspension to a centrifuge tube and spin at 1,000 × g for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Lyse cells with RLT
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL of RLT lysis buffer directly to the cell pellet and mix briefly.

steps.title: Quantify RNA
steps.instruction: Measure RNA concentration using a Nanodrop or similar spectrophotometer and assess RNA quality.

steps.title: Submit RNA for library prep
steps.instruction: Send 1 µg of total RNA to Azenta/GENEWIZ for library preparation and sequencing.

steps.title: Pseudo‑align FASTQ files
steps.instruction: Use kallisto to pseudo‑align the FASTQ files to the reference genome GRCh38.p13.
